name: Historic Town of Banská Štiavnica and the Technical Monuments in its Vicinity
description: Banská Štiavnica is a small town in central Slovakia, built on the slopes of a vast caldera left by a collapsed ancient volcano. It grew rich from medieval mining, and its hillsides still hold Renaissance palaces, 16th-century churches, castles and graceful squares. Beyond the streets, the surrounding landscape is dotted with mining and metalworking relics, so town and countryside read as one story.
